description: Specification for .faf, an IANA-registered YAML format (application/vnd.faf+yaml) for a project's facts: name, goal, stack and the six W's, in project.faf. Covers the 33 slots and how a score is worked out, JSON Schemas, conformance files, and the sibling formats .fafm (memory) and .fafa (agents).
rules: Name the file project.faf and keep it beside package.json; tools look for project.faf first, and the hidden name .faf still parses.
A valid .faf file parses as YAML and has faf_version and project.name; every other field is optional.
Each slot is populated, empty or slotignored; slotignored means the slot does not apply to the project's app type and does not count toward the score.
